# External Source Metadata Index

**Status:** ACTIVE — external-source metadata index  
**Scope:** Upstream source declarations, acquisition status, inspection records, and licensing notes  
**Authority:** DATA / SOURCE METADATA index; this file does not make upstream records into Berean
Evidence, Claims, Entities, Events, Propositions, relationships, or derived knowledge.

This directory records external upstream sources that may support future Berean ingestion. Raw
upstream data remains outside the authoritative Berean model until it is explicitly acquired,
inspected, transformed, cited, loaded through provenance-preserving workflows, and validated.

| Source directory | Upstream identity | Current status |
|---|---|---|
| [`stepbible/`](./stepbible/) | `STEPBible/STEPBible-Data` | One pinned file acquired and inspected; no upstream payload is tracked in this repository. |
| [`theographic/`](./theographic/) | `robertrouse/theographic-bible-metadata` | Metadata-only declaration; acquisition pending. |
| [`bible-data/`](./bible-data/) | `BradyStephenson/bible-data` | Metadata-only declaration; acquisition pending; license declarations require dataset/file-level clarification. |

See each source directory for its `README.md`, `SOURCE_METADATA.md`, and manifest files.
